sections.title: Morning Shift (06:40 – 14:30)
items: Equipment handover: 4x Keys, 2x Swipe Cards, 2x Vests, 2x Radios, 1x Ops Phone, 2x Cameras plus 1 Charger.
Patrolling up Queen Street, full sweep. All clear, no issues.
Arrived at check-in Aotea Square; full walkthrough completed. A few streeties sleeping outside the old Coffee Club at Metro Entertainment Building. Standby for presence and response calls.
Received a response call from McDonald's Queen Street regarding a male individual harassing two female adults.
Arrived at response location; spoke with the POI and asked him to leave the premises politely. As we enforced our presence the individual left the area. No further issues.
Arrived at check-in top of Mayoral Drive; walked around towards Cook Street. No issues found.
Patrolling through Upper Federal Street; welfare checks completed on Star Convenience Store and City Mission. Continuing down Federal Street.
Arrived at check-in top of Victoria Street; welfare check on all area stores, no issues. Standby for presence and response calls.
Walked around the Cathedral Church and Federal Square and scoped the location for any vagrants or issues.
Welfare check on Albert Mart Convenience Store and Discount Dairy, all clear.
Arrived at check-in corner of Customs and Albert Street intersection.
Welfare check within Metro Woolworths; stopped for coffee/drinks to stay hydrated.
Arrived at the last checkpoint for Charlie Route, Commercial Bay; full walkthrough completed. Welfare checks commenced on open stores within Rutland, Tyler and Quay Street.
Arrived back at TK Square, standing by to show presence before moving along.
Ending Charlie Route but continuing standby to show presence.
No further issues during standby at TK Square.
Commencing Delta Route from TK Square, heading towards Aotea.
Full sweep Elliott Stables, all clear, no issues.
Victoria Street full sweep, all clear, no issues.
Response call received from Puffing Kiwi on High Street regarding a male attempting to shoplift from the store.
Arrived at response location. POI had left the store but guards retrieved footage of the incident. Standby for incident report. Heading back to HQ for Ops phone charging.
Arrived at HQ office; charging Ops phone, standing by for calls.
Commencing patrols — Alpha Route. Heading down towards Commercial Bay for sweep.
Arrived at Commercial Bay; full sweep and welfare check on Britomart McDonald's. Lower Albert Street sweep completed. All clear. Heading towards Victoria Street.
Arrived at Victoria Street; welfare checks on stores, all clear. Heading to Aotea Square for the last Alpha Route checkpoint.
Arrived at Aotea Square; full comprehensive sweep, all clear. Standing by for response calls.
Commencing Beta Route; making our way to Victoria Street with welfare checks along the way, all clear.
Sweep High Street, all clear; welfare checks on stores complete.
Full sweep Chancery Square; welfare checks on stores and restaurants, all clear.
Sweep Fort Street, Fort Lane, Vulcan Lane, all clear; welfare checks on stores. Standing by at Fort Street for response calls.
Arrived at HQ; 30-minute break and standing by for calls and shift handover.
Morning shift completed. All clear, no issues to report.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:50 – 22:30)
items: Equipment handover: 4x Keys, 2x Swipe Cards, 2x Vests, 2x Radios, 1x Ops Phone, 2x Cameras plus 1 Charger.
Debrief with morning shift and Team 2 complete. Commencing welfare checks up Queen Street while Team 2 head down towards Commercial Bay.
Welfare sweep along Queen Street complete; no issues from local stores. Continuing patrol.
Welfare sweep along Aotea Square; no issues.
Welfare sweep Elliott Street / Darby / Elliott Stables, clear. Heading up to Victoria Street.
Welfare sweep around Victoria Street, clear. Heading to the Cathedral for welfare sweep.
Welfare check on the Cathedral, clear. Making our way to Lorne Street while maintaining presence on Queen Street.
Welfare check on Auckland Library, clear.
Welfare checks for Team 1 complete, no issues. Maintaining presence along Queen Street, heading back to HQ for Team 2 stand down.
Debrief with Team 2 complete. Commencing patrol down Queen Street.
Full welfare sweep complete on lower Queen Street; no issues from local stores. Continuing patrol to Commercial Bay.
Full welfare sweep on Commercial Bay complete; no issues.
Welfare sweep through Gore Street; no issues from stores.
Fort Street welfare sweep complete; no issues.
Welfare sweep through High Street, clear.
Welfare check on Chancery Square and Freyberg Square, clear.
Welfare sweeps complete, no issues. Maintaining presence along Queen Street; standing by for response calls.
Response call from McDonald's Queen Street regarding a male vagrant inside being aggressive towards staff; he then tried to enter the McDonald's cashier area but failed.

Arrived and did a welfare check on staff, who identified the suspect; he had been trying to grab a phone. Staff managed to get him out. Last seen heading down Queen Street. Standing by at Maccas Queen Street.

Stood down from McDonald's Queen Street; Police have been on site and all information about the aggressive POI was given. Brief debrief with P4G security (also on site due to the panic alarm). No further issues. Resuming presence along Queen Street heading up to Aotea Square.
Full sweep along Upper Queen Street, clear; Lorne Street clear.
Auckland Library welfare check complete, no issues.
Elliott Stables, Elliott Street, Darby welfare sweep complete, no issues.
Heading back to HQ for 30 and guard handover.
Afternoon shift complete. Handover complete, all clear.

Note (reported retrospectively during patrol): MacPac reported a theft today at approx. 12:30 — vagrants seen taking a jacket worth $450. HOTC was not contacted at the time; guards reminded staff to contact HOTC in any situation, even if only suspicious. Staff compliant and understood.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:45 – 06:32)
items: Equipment received: 4x Keys, 2x Body Cameras, 2x Swipe Cards, 2x Vests, 1x Ops Phone.
Alpha Route — check-in Chemist Warehouse / Kathmandu, all clear.
Patrolling Commercial Bay, commencing full sweep.
Commercial Bay all clear, no issues.
Welfare check Albert Street Convenience Store, no issues.
Full sweep Victoria Street, all clear.
Full sweep Lorne Street, all clear. Heading back to HQ for floor checks.
Check-in Queen Street Maccas, no issues.
Patrolling Aotea Square, commencing full sweep.
Aotea Square full sweep complete, all clear. Alpha Route complete.
Check-in Queen Street Maccas, no issues.
Full sweep Freyberg / Chancery Square / Kitchener Street, all clear.
Full sweep Fort Street / Wilson Carpark, all clear.
Check-in Aotea Gifts, all clear. Beta Route complete.
Check-in St Patrick's Cathedral Church, all clear. Heading back to HQ; 2nd guard has arrived.
Full sweep Victoria Street, all clear.
Check-in corner of Lorne Street / Wakefield, no issues.
Check-in Queen Street Maccas, no issues.
Full sweep through Elliott Street and Darby Street, all clear.
Welfare check 77 Convenience Victoria Street, all clear.

Serious / notable: Aggressive male vagrant at McDonald's Queen Street attempting to grab a phone — Police and P4G attended, panic alarm activated (19:39-20:45). Attempted shoplift at Puffing Kiwi, High Street — POI gone, footage retrieved (11:27). MacPac $450 jacket theft reported late; HOTC not contacted at the time (approx. 12:30).
